title: Reorder final layout sections and ensure dog-with-rose image appears above romantic lines

requirements.summary: Move the lip-biting image section to render below FinalNote and above FooterSignature with a visible vertical gap, keeping all other visuals/copy unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: After the envelope is opened and the experience completes, the page order is: FinalNote text block → (gap) Lip-biting image + caption → FooterSignature text.
Lip-biting section is not shown above or inside the FinalNote content.
No cards/frames/containers are introduced around the lip-biting image; it sits directly on the cinematic background.
All previously existing sections (envelope, Image 1 area, romantic lines, petals if enabled, final note, footer) keep their current styling and behavior except for the lip-biting section’s placement.

file_operations.description: Reorder the final-stage render tree so the lip-biting section is rendered between FinalNote and FooterSignature, while ensuring the lip-biting reveal/progression logic still occurs during the pre-final stage (without rendering it above the FinalNote).

Add a non-timed/static rendering mode (or equivalent) so the lip-biting image+caption can be shown in the final layout location without triggering/restarting timed progression, and without introducing any new card/frame/container UI.
Add/adjust styling to create a clear vertical gap between the FinalNote block and the lip-biting section in its new final-stage placement, without changing other section styling.

requirements.summary: Update the lip-biting emoji caption text exactly and ensure it appears with the lip-biting image in its new location.
acceptanceCriteria: The caption renders exactly as: “This is me when I see you:)”.
The previous caption text (“This is when I see you…”) is not displayed anywhere.

file_operations.description: Change the caption string to render exactly “This is me when I see you:)” (matching capitalization/punctuation) and ensure it is rendered alongside the lip-biting image in the final placement behavior.

requirements.summary: Ensure Image 1 (dog holding a rose) is displayed directly above the first romantic line using a local /assets/generated path, and is omitted entirely if it fails to load.
acceptanceCriteria: When the envelope transitions to the romantic lines section, the dog-with-rose image is visible above the first romantic line on a normal load.
The Image 1 asset is loaded from a local path under /assets/generated (no external URLs).
If the Image 1 asset fails to load, the app shows no broken-image icon and continues the flow with the text still visible.

file_operations.description: Verify the Image 1 src uses the correct local static asset path under /assets/generated and that the component continues to fully omit rendering on load failure (no broken-image icon), while keeping it positioned above the romantic lines.

Confirm RoseReveal is rendered immediately before the first romantic line sequence (TimedRomanticLines) in the romantic-lines stage so Image 1 appears above “I brought you a rose today…” on a normal load.

requirements.summary: Maintain one-time, end-to-end stage progression per page load without looping, and ensure final note + footer always render even if images fail, while reflecting the new lip-biting placement.
acceptanceCriteria: The experience progresses once per page load with no repeated/looped timed sequences caused by re-renders.
FinalNote and FooterSignature always render after the envelope is opened, even if Image 1 and/or the lip-biting image fails to load.
The lip-biting section appears in the final layout position (below FinalNote, above FooterSignature) without causing stage-flow regressions or re-triggers.

file_operations.description: Adjust the stage/render wiring so the timed reveal completion callbacks still advance stages exactly once, while the final-stage UI order becomes FinalNote → (gap) Lip-biting section → FooterSignature, and image failures do not prevent reaching the final stage.

Ensure the lip-biting reveal logic cannot retrigger/blink due to remounts/re-renders, and that image load failure still triggers completion so the app always reaches final note + footer; keep safe omission behavior on image error.
Confirm the one-time timers/completion guard remains stable under the updated App render order so the romantic lines sequence does not loop or restart.
